senses.gloss: 1. औ॑र्व m. a descendant of Ūrva, N. of a Ṛṣi, RV. viii, 102, 4; TS. vii; AitBr.; MBh. &c.
N. of a son of Vasiṣṭha, Hariv.
औ॑र्व m. pl. N. of a class of Pitṛs, TāṇḍyaBr.; Lāṭy.
औ॑र्व mfn. produced by or relating to the Ṛṣi Aurva, MBh. i, 387, &c.
औ॑र्व m. the submarine fire (cast into the ocean by Aurva Bhārgava cf. above).
2. और्व mf(ई)n. (fr. उर्वी), relating to the earth, of the earth, VarBṛS.
और्व n. fossil salt, L.
औ॑र्वी f. a female descendant of Ūrva, Kāś. on Pāṇ. iv, 1, 73
औ॑र्व-कल्प-ग्रन्थ m. N. of wk. on medicine.
और्व—दहन m. the submarine fire, Rājat.
औ॑र्व-प्रकार m. N. of wk. on medicine.
औ॑र्व-प्रयोग m. N. of wk. on medicine.
और्वाग्नि m. id., Prab.; Śiś.
और्वानल m. id., Kād.
और्वाय Nom. Ā. और्वायते, to behave like the submarine fire, Veṇīs.
और्वर mfn. (fr. उर्वरा), relating to or coming from the earth, coming from the ground (as dust), Śiś. xvi, 27.
और्वश mfn. containing the word उर्वशी (as an Adhyāya or Anuvāka) g. विमुक्तादि, Pāṇ. v, 2, 61.
और्वशेय m. a descendant of Urvaśī, Vikr.
N. of Agastya, L.
